                <span class="module-beat-num">02 / SQUADS</span>
                <h1>Squads</h1>
                <p>Prefer a smaller social way to meet? Start with a shared Taste — coffee circles, food walks, and other labelled examples until they are real.</p>
              </div>
              <div class="module-beat-photo">
                <img
                  src="/media/elaris-gatherings-cafe.png"
                  alt="A mixed group of friends sharing chai and snacks in a cafe"
                  width="1100"
                  height="880"
                />
              </div>
            </article>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="step-body">
        <div class="shell">
          <h2>Inside this chapter</h2>
          <p class="section-lede">
            Grouped by compatible age band, geography, intent and the purpose of the gathering. Taste is a context signal, not the only admission rule. We do not promise romance from an event.
          </p>

          <div class="principle-row">
            <div class="principle-icon" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" fill="none">
                <circle cx="46" cy="60" r="22" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="7" />
                <circle cx="74" cy="60" r="22" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="7" />
                <path d="M36 60h20M64 60h20" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <div class="principle-copy">
              <h3>Same network. Another way to cross paths.</h3>
              <p>
                A gathering is an activation of the local singles network — not a separate product. Published only when host, venue, capacity and a safety owner are real.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="principle-row reverse">
            <div class="principle-icon" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" fill="none">
                <path
                  d="M38 78c0-18 14-30 22-30s22 12 22 30"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  stroke-width="7"
                  stroke-linecap="round"
                />
                <path d="M48 48c0-10 6-16 12-16s12 6 12 16" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" />
                <path d="M52 88h16" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            <div class="principle-copy">
              <h3>Low pressure. Public by default.</h3>
              <p>
                Visible host. No forced pairings. Photo consent before pictures. Prefer recommended public places and partner venues where available.
                <a class="text-link" href="/safety#gathering-safety">Safety at gatherings →</a>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="principle-row">
            <div class="principle-icon" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" fill="none">

              </svg>
            </div>
            <div class="principle-copy">
              <h3>Coffee circle</h3>
              <p>
                A small public-table meetup. Visible host. No forced pairings. One picture of what a founding week could feel like — not a live listing.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="principle-row reverse">
            <div class="principle-icon" aria-hidden="true">

            <div class="principle-copy">
              <h3>Food walk</h3>
              <p>
                A short neighbourhood walk with a clear start point, capacity and cancellation policy. Coming to the founding cohort when the logistics are real.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="principle-row">

              <h3>Run + breakfast</h3>
              <p>
                Movement first, then a public breakfast. Photo consent before any pictures. An example only, until a host and venue are confirmed.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

              <h3>Book / culture meet</h3>
              <p>
                A low-pressure circle around a book, film or live-music night. Published only when the logistics are real.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div class="principle-copy">
              <h3>Taste as context, not a score</h3>
              <p>
                Shared interests, energy and lifestyle help us group people. Enough signal to meet well — never a compatibility percentage.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="principle-row reverse" id="reconnect">
            <div class="principle-icon" aria-hidden="true">

            </div>
            <div class="principle-copy">
              <h3>If you want to reconnect</h3>
              <p>
                After a gathering, mark it privately. A connection opens only when it is mutual. No public attendee ratings.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
